verses.saheeh: By the sky containing great stars
verses.khattab: By the sky full of constellations
verses.jalalayn: ﻿By the heaven of the constellations, the twelve constellations of the planets — as explained in [sūrat] al-Furqān [Q. 25:61];
verses.romanUrdu: Kasam hai mazboot qalon waley (impregnable castles )aasman ki

verses.saheeh: And [by] the promised Day
verses.khattab: and the promised Day ˹of Judgment˺
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and [by] the promised day, the Day of Resurrection;
verses.romanUrdu: Aur us din ki jiska wada kiya gaya hai

verses.saheeh: And [by] the witness and what is witnessed,
verses.khattab: and the witness and what is witnessed
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and [by] the witness, Friday, and the witnessed, the day of ‘Arafa — that is how these three [elements] have been explained in hadīth: for the first one is ‘promised’, the second one is ‘a witness’ [that testifies] to deeds performed in it, while the third is ‘witnessed’ by mankind and angels (the introductory [particle] of the response to the oath has been omitted, but is implied to be laqad, ‘verily’, [sc. laqad qutila ashābu’l-ukhdūd]):
verses.romanUrdu: Aur dekhnay walay ki aur dekhi janey wali cheez ki

verses.saheeh: Cursed were the companions of the trench
verses.khattab: Condemned are the makers of the ditch—
verses.jalalayn: ﻿perish, accursed be, the men of the ditch!, the pit in the ground,
verses.romanUrdu: kay maarey gaye gaddey(pit) waley

verses.saheeh: [Containing] the fire full of fuel,
verses.khattab: the fire ˹pit˺, filled with fuel—
verses.jalalayn: ﻿of the fire (al-nāri is an inclusive substitution of it [al-ukhdūdi, ‘of the ditch’]), abounding in fuel, by which it was fuelled,
verses.romanUrdu: uss gaddey(pit) waley] jis mei khoob bhadakte huey indhan ki aag thi

verses.saheeh: When they were sitting near it
verses.khattab: when they sat around it
verses.jalalayn: ﻿when they sat by it, around the edge of the ditch on chairs,
verses.romanUrdu: jabke woh us gaddey ke kinare par baithay huey thay

verses.uthmani: وَهُمۡ عَلَىٰ مَا يَفۡعَلُونَ بِٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ شُهُودٞ
verses.indopak: وَّهُمْ عَلٰى مَا يَفْعَلُوْنَ بِالْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ شُهُوْدٌۗ
verses.saheeh: And they, to what they were doing against the believers, were witnesses.
verses.khattab: watching what they had ˹ordered to be˺ done to the believers
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and they themselves, to what they did to those who believed, in God, in the way of torturing them by hurling [them] into the fire when they did not recant their faith, were witnesses, [they were themselves] present [thereat]. It is reported [in a hadīth] that God saved the believers who had been thrown into the fire by taking their souls before they fell into it, and that the fire then rose up and burnt all those [sitting] around it.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur jo kuch woh imaan laney walon ke saath kar rahey thay usey dekh rahey thay

verses.uthmani: وَمَا نَقَمُواْ مِنۡهُمۡ إِلَّآ أَن يُؤۡمِنُواْ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلۡعَزِيزِ ٱلۡحَمِيدِ
verses.indopak: وَمَا نَقَمُوْا مِنْهُمْ اِلَّاۤ اَنْ يُّؤْمِنُوْا بِاللّٰهِ الْعَزِيْزِ الْحَمِيْدِۙ
verses.transliteration: wama naqamoo minhum illa an yuminoo biallahi al'azeezi alhameedi
verses.saheeh: And they resented them not except because they believed in Allah, the Exalted in Might, the Praiseworthy,
verses.khattab: who they resented for no reason other than belief in Allah—the Almighty, the Praiseworthy—
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And all that they were vindicative towards them of was that they believed in God, the Mighty, in His kingdom, the Praised,
verses.romanUrdu: Aur un ehley imaan se unki dushmani iske siwa kisi wajah se na thi ke woh us khuda par imaan le aaye thay jo zabardast aur apni zaat mei aap mahmood(praiseworthy) hai

verses.uthmani: ٱلَّذِي لَهُۥ مُلۡكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۚوَٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ شَهِيدٌ
verses.indopak: الَّذِىْ لَهٗ مُلْكُ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالْاَرْضِۗوَ اللّٰهُ عَلٰى كُلِّ شَىْءٍ شَهِيْدٌۗ
verses.transliteration: allathee lahu mulku alssamawati waalardi waallahu 'ala kulli shayin shaheedun
verses.saheeh: To whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth. And Allah, over all things, is Witness.
verses.khattab: ˹the One˺ to Whom belongs the kingdom of the heavens and earth. And Allah is a Witness over all things
verses.jalalayn: ﻿to Whom belongs the kingdom of the heavens and the earth, and God is Witness to all things, in other words, all that the disbelievers disavowed of the believers was their faith.
verses.romanUrdu: Jo aasmano aur zameen ki sultanat ka maalik hai, aur woh khuda sab kuch dekh raha hai

verses.uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ فَتَنُواْ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ وَٱلۡمُؤۡمِنَٰتِ ثُمَّ لَمۡ يَتُوبُواْ فَلَهُمۡ عَذَابُ جَهَنَّمَ وَلَهُمۡ عَذَابُ ٱلۡحَرِيقِ
verses.indopak: اِنَّ الَّذِيْنَ فَتَـنُوا الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ وَ الْمُؤْمِنٰتِ ثُمَّ لَمْ يَتُوْبُوْا فَلَهُمْ عَذَابُ جَهَنَّمَ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابُ الْحَرِيْقِۗ
verses.transliteration: inna allatheena fatanoo almumineena waalmuminati thumma lam yatooboo falahum 'athabu jahannama walahum 'athabu alhareeqi
verses.saheeh: Indeed, those who have tortured the believing men and believing women and then have not repented will have the punishment of Hell, and they will have the punishment of the Burning Fire.
verses.khattab: Those who persecute the believing men and women and then do not repent will certainly suffer the punishment of Hell and the torment of burning
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Indeed those who persecute believing men and believing women, by having them burnt, then do not repent, there will be for them the chastisement of Hell, [in return] for their disbelief, and there will [also] be for them the chastisement of burning, that is to say, the chastisement for their having had the believers burnt, in the Hereafter; but it is also said [that there is this chastisement for them] in this world, as when the fire rose up and burnt them, as [mentioned] above.
verses.romanUrdu: Jin logon ne momin mardon aur auraton par zulm o sitam toda aur phir ussey taib na huey, yaqeenan unke liye jahannum ka azaab hai aur unke liye jalaye janey ki saza hai

verses.uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ لَهُمۡ جَنَّٰتٞ تَجۡرِي مِن تَحۡتِهَا ٱلۡأَنۡهَٰرُۚذَٰلِكَ ٱلۡفَوۡزُ ٱلۡكَبِيرُ
verses.indopak: اِنَّ الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ لَهُمْ جَنّٰتٌ تَجْرِىْ مِنْ تَحْتِهَا الْاَنْهٰرُۗذٰلِكَ الْفَوْزُ الْكَبِيْرُۗ
verses.transliteration: inna allatheena amanoo wa'amiloo alssalihati lahum jannatun tajree min tahtiha alanharu thalika alfawzu alkabeeru
verses.saheeh: Indeed, those who have believed and done righteous deeds will have gardens beneath which rivers flow. That is the great attainment.
verses.khattab: Surely those who believe and do good will have Gardens under which rivers flow. That is the greatest triumph
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Indeed those who believe and perform righteous deeds, for them there will be gardens underneath which rivers flow: that is the supreme triumph.
verses.romanUrdu: Jo log imaan laaye aur jinho ne neik amal kiye yaqeenan unke liye jannat ke baagh hain jinke nichey nehrein behti hongi, yeh hai badi kamyabi

verses.saheeh: Indeed, the vengeance of your Lord is severe.
verses.khattab: Indeed, the ˹crushing˺ grip of your Lord is severe
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Assuredly your Lord’s assault, against the disbelievers, is severe, [as severe] as He will [it to be].
verses.romanUrdu: Dar haqeeqat tumharey Rubb ki pakad badi sakht hai

verses.saheeh: Indeed, it is He who originates [creation] and repeats.
verses.khattab: ˹For˺ He is certainly the One Who originates and resurrects ˹all˺
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Assuredly it is He Who originates, creation, and restores, and is never thwarted in what He wills,
verses.romanUrdu: Wahi pehli baar paida karta hai aur wahi dobara paida karega

verses.saheeh: And He is the Forgiving, the Affectionate,
verses.khattab: And He is the All-Forgiving, All-Loving—
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and He is the Forgiving, to sinning believers, the Loving, the One Who shows love to His friends through [His acts of] generosity,
verses.romanUrdu: Aur woh bakshne wala hai, mohabbat karne wala hai

verses.saheeh: Honorable Owner of the Throne,
verses.khattab: Lord of the Throne, the All-Glorious
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Lord of the Throne, its Creator and Possessor, the Glorious (read nominative al-majīdu), the One deserving of the perfect attributes of sublimity,
verses.romanUrdu: Arsh ka maalik hai, buzurg-o-bartar hai

verses.saheeh: Effecter of what He intends.
verses.khattab: Doer of whatever He wills
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Doer of what He desires, nothing able to thwart Him.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur jo kuch chahey kar daalney wala hai

verses.saheeh: Has there reached you the story of the soldiers -
verses.khattab: Has the story of the ˹destroyed˺ forces reached you ˹O Prophet˺—
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Have you, O Muhammad (s), received the story of the hosts,
verses.romanUrdu: Kya tumhey lashkaron ki khabar pahunchi hai

verses.saheeh: [Those of] Pharaoh and Thamud?
verses.khattab: ˹the forces of˺ Pharaoh and Thamûd
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Pharaoh and Thamūd? (Fir‘awna wa-Thamūda substitutes for al-junūdi) — the mention of ‘Pharaoh’ suffices to also include his followers; their ‘story’ is that they were destroyed for their disbelief, and this is meant as a warning for those who deny the Prophet (s) and the Qur'an, that they may be admonished [thereby].
verses.romanUrdu: Firoun aur samood (ke lashkaron) ki

verses.saheeh: But they who disbelieve are in [persistent] denial,
verses.khattab: Yet the disbelievers ˹still˺ persist in denial
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Nay, but the disbelievers are [engrossed] in denial, of the mentioned;
verses.romanUrdu: Magar jinho ne kufr kiya hai woh jhutlaney mein lagey huey hain

verses.saheeh: While Allah encompasses them from behind.
verses.khattab: But Allah encompasses them from all sides
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and God is behind them, All-Encompassing — they have no protector against Him.
verses.romanUrdu: Halaanke Allah ne unko gherey mein le rakha hai

verses.saheeh: But this is an honored Qur'an
verses.khattab: In fact, this is a glorious Quran
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Nay, but it is a glorious, a magnificent, Qur'an,
verses.romanUrdu: (unke jhutlaney se iss quran ka kuch nahin bigadta) balkey yeh quran buland paya hai

verses.saheeh: [Inscribed] in a Preserved Slate.
verses.khattab: ˹recorded˺ in a Preserved Tablet
verses.jalalayn: ﻿in a tablet, suspended above the seventh heaven, preserved (read mahfūzin), from all devils and from having any of its contents altered; it is a high as the distance between the earth and the heaven, and as wide as the distance between the east and the west, made of white pearls — as stated by Ibn ‘Abbās, may God be pleased with both [him and his father, ‘Abbās
verses.romanUrdu: Us loah mei (naqsh hai) jo mehfooz hai
